test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A car covers a distance of 1032 km in 8 hours. The speed of a train is double the speed of the car. One-third the speed of the train is equal to the speed of a bike. How much distance will the bike cover in 17 hours?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
**Speed of Car** = 1032 ÷ 8 = 129 kmph.

**Speed of Train** = 2 × 129 = 258 kmph.

**Speed of Bike** = 1/3 × 258 = 86 kmph.

**Distance by Bike** = 86 × 17 = 1462 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 1462 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Car Distance** = 1032 km, **Car Time** = 8 hours.

**Formula Used:**

**Speed** = Distance ÷ Time

**Distance** = Speed × Time
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e417bd8e46944b4ca89a222810deccaf0b277f7172392857799336b04a52b45b.png] 
**Calculations:**

⇒ **Speed of Car** = 1032 ÷ 8 = 129 kmph

⇒ **Speed of Train** = 2 × 129 = 258 kmph

⇒ **Speed of Bike** = 258 ÷ 3 = 86 kmph

⇒ **Distance covered by Bike in 17 hours** = 86 × 17

⇒ **Distance** = 1462 km

**∴ The correct answer is 1462 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Conversion of Speed Units

To convert **kmph** to **m/s**, multiply by 5/18. To convert **m/s** to **kmph**, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed

For two equal distances covered at speeds **x** and **y**, **Average Speed** = (2 × x × y) ÷ (x + y).

Relative Speed

In the **same direction**, subtract speeds (u − v). In the **opposite direction**, add speeds (u + v).</p
